description: Google Ads Transparency Center: search advertisers by name or domain (verified name, advertiser ID, country, approximate ad count), or list the ads of an advertiser ID or website domain (creative ID, format, first and last shown dates, days shown, preview URL, Transparency Center link), optionally for one country; plus the approximate total number of ads. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

advertiserId.description: Advertiser ID (AR + 20 digits) to list its ads

domain.description: Website domain to list ads pointing to it, e.g. nike.com

q.description: Advertiser name or domain to search, e.g. nike (returns advertisers)

region.description: Optional country code (US, GB, DE, TR...) or Google geo criteria ID for ads shown there

name: search_google_ads
title: Search Google Ads
